command:
cd /home/runner/work/boo4blue.github.io/boo4blue.github.io/cloud-pc/storage/rvc-training/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI
LOG="../rvc-training.log"
echo "=== RVC Fix Job - $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "[1/3] Re-downloading HuBERT (was truncated)..." | tee -a "$LOG"
rm -f assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt
curl -L --retry 3 -o assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt "https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/hubert_base.pt" 2>&1 | tail -3 | tee -a "$LOG"
ls -lh assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "[2/3] Converting audio with Python (no ffmpeg)..." | tee -a "$LOG"
python3 << 'PYEOF2' 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
import soundfile as sf
import numpy as np
audio, sr = sf.read('../naruto-mega-ref.flac')
print(f'Loaded: {len(audio)/sr:.1f}s at {sr}Hz, shape {audio.shape}')
# Resample to 40000 if needed (simple - assume 24000 input, upsample)
if sr != 40000:
    import librosa
    audio = librosa.resample(audio, orig_sr=sr, target_sr=40000)
    print(f'Resampled to 40000Hz, len {len(audio)}')
# Ensure mono
if len(audio.shape) > 1:
    audio = audio.mean(axis=1)
# Save
import os
os.makedirs('dataset/naruto-en', exist_ok=True)
sf.write('dataset/naruto-en/naruto-ref.wav', audio, 40000)
print(f'Saved dataset/naruto-en/naruto-ref.wav')
PYEOF2
ls -lh dataset/naruto-en/ | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "[3/3] Verifying all files..." | tee -a "$LOG"
python3 -c "
import os
h = os.path.getsize('assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt')
g = os.path.getsize('assets/pretrained/f0G40k.pth')
d = os.path.getsize('assets/pretrained/f0D40k.pth')
w = os.path.getsize('dataset/naruto-en/naruto-ref.wav')
print(f'hubert: {h/1e6:.0f}MB (need >300)')
print(f'f0G: {g/1e6:.0f}MB, f0D: {d/1e6:.0f}MB')
print(f'wav: {w/1e6:.0f}MB')
assert h > 300e6, 'HuBERT still bad'
assert w > 10e6, 'WAV too small'
print('ALL FILES OK')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "=== Fix complete ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
